style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, soft mist-blue #E7EFFA for benefit and detail screens, cobalt #1D62E0 panels for the step and close screens; one background family per shot, never mixed

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool apothecary skincare commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, cobalt accent #1D62E0, soft mist-blue #E7EFFA and charcoal text #2B2F33; cool-neutral high-key studio lighting with a broad front key, soft bounce fill and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with every piece of in-image copy removed and left as blank placeholder bands; thin single-weight hairline icons, leader lines and round label chips in cobalt #1D62E0 only; matte white acrylic, pale water-ripple glass and light stone surfaces; stable low jar scale, centered or pushed to one third; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no rendered marketing copy.
noDrift: no rendered marketing copy or numerals
style.presentationRules: keep the low wide-mouth jar scale stable, lid closed on packshots and open on usage screens, product centered or pushed to one third so the opposite side stays clear for copy
style.surfaceSystem: matte white acrylic, pale water-ripple glass #DCEAF7 and light stone neutral #EFEBE6 counters
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, all marketing copy removed at template level and left as blank headline and label bands
